title: R001: Responder_001
description: Sample acquisition: Archival melanoma specimens of patients treated with anti-PD-1 (either pembrolizumab or nivolumab) monotherapy were obtained via an ongoing clinical trial (NCT02694965). After verification by a board-certified pathologist, microdissection was performed if deemed necessary. | de-identified patient samples were labeled according to response and time of sample acquisition
data_processing: Samples were analyzed on a NanoString nCounter Max system using the nCounter Vantage 3D Human Wnt Pathways Panel (N2_WNT_Pth_v1.0), which is comprised of Wnt ligands, receptors, regulators, gene targets, and other pathway components with the addition of a custom gene panel composed of cytolytic T cell markers and IDO1.  Analysis was performed using the nSolver software.
